objective: Compose the ACC-6 semantic-plane journey (M05 ontology, M03 authority, M01 daemon effect boundary) into one runnable check over the existing unit done-bars, on one basis, against each done-bar's own real daemon with fixtures disabled.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:acceptance-semantic-plane runs every ACC-6 positive clause's done-bar and the minutes-scale negative-clause battery sequentially in one process, re-reads the git basis after every clause, clears every shared-daemon/replay redirection variable for every child, and reports PASS only when every clause (including every negative clause's executed mutation battery) is green; without `-- --mutation-batteries` it reports PARTIAL at best, never PASS.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: npm run mutate:acceptance-semantic-plane proves a planted red clause fails the journey; the full-depth run executes every negative clause's planted mutation battery and requires each red-on-target: semantic-mapping 27/27, admission-census 41 anchors, data-recipe 23/23, version-lifecycle 10/10, provenance-assertion 21/21, action-contract 22/22, invariant-11 23/23. The runner's earlier runs caught two censuses the release accounting had been citing as real without re-running, and then caught leg 1's own stale census pin on the committed tree.
remaining_nonclaims: The runner certifies nothing a done-bar does not itself assert; clause coverage is the done-bars' coverage.
Without --mutation-batteries the runner reports PARTIAL: the negative clauses are unproven in that lane by construction.
